sources.name: DEC-316: resilience_signal_low (protection=0)
sources.detail: Phase-1 documented: deep oracle scan (DEC-316) found no honest protection-tagged candidates. Purphoros's indestructibility is incidental (main role is the ETB drain trigger), and Cavern of Souls' 'can't be countered' clause needs tribal density that this Norin etb-flicker deck (8+ creature types) doesn't have. Closing this gap requires a Phase-2 card swap. Margin stays +-8 until then.

guideContent.strategyOverview:
Norin the Wary is a {R} 0/1 Legendary Human Warrior whose static ability flickers him at the start of every combat and whenever a creature comes under an opponent's control. The deck weaponizes that repeating ETB into a static damage stack — every flicker triggers every passive 'when a creature ETBs' effect on the board.

The engine layer is the static damage stack: Impact Tremors, Witty Roastmaster, Agate Instigator, Molten Gatekeeper, Electrostatic Field, Genesis Chamber, Warstorm Surge, Purphoros (God of the Forge), Terror of the Peaks, and Pandemonium. Each one pings 1-N damage per ETB. Young Pyromancer prints Elemental tokens off every I/S spell, feeding the chain. Pia Nalaar (the c21 mono-R, mana cost {2}{R}) drops a Thopter on her own ETB and supplies an artifact-sac/anthem activation. Pia and Kiran Nalaar enter with two Thopters of their own.

The multiplier layer is the deck's identity: Torbran, Thane of Red Fell adds +2 to each red source's damage to opponents; Mechanized Warfare adds +1 to each artifact/red-source damage; Panharmonicon doubles every ETB trigger; Fiery Emancipation triples all damage. Stack two multipliers and a single Norin flicker under Impact Tremors + Purphoros + Torbran becomes 3 ping × 4 = 12 damage per opponent per flicker — and Norin flickers every combat AND every opponent-creature-ETB.

Card draw is wheel-heavy, leaning into Norin's empty hand: Reforge the Soul, Wheel of Misfortune, and Magus of the Wheel are three 7-card refills. Outpost Siege gives passive impulse draw + drain mode. Tome of Legends is a Norin-specific engine — he triggers it every combat. Idol of Oblivion + Skullclamp + Faithless Looting + Bedlam Reveler + Rose Room Treasurer round out the draw suite. Hammer of Purphoros prints Elemental tokens (more ETBs) and grants haste — Norin's flicker on entry skips summoning sickness, but Hammer matters for fresh fatties (Etali, Inferno Titan, Terror of the Peaks).

Win lines: (1) Primary — Static drain via Norin's repeating flicker + 2-4 ETB pingers + 1-2 multipliers. T7-T9 lethal across the table is the goldfish line. (2) Secondary — Combat alpha via Hellrider (drains 1 per attacker) + Hanweir Garrison (two 1/1 tokens per combat) + Hammer haste + Combat Celebrant's exert (untap and attack again). (3) Optional — Etali, Primal Storm's combat trigger casts free spells off opponents' decks, often spiraling into a free wincon.

No Game Changers (0). The deck targets Bracket 3 — power floor is high (T8 lethal goldfish) but the ceiling is capped by the no-GC constraint: no Mana Crypt / Jeweled Lotus / fast-mana, no Dockside, no tutors stronger than Goblin Recruiter (cut for differentiation), no Mana Vault. Interaction is 7 slots wide (Bolt, Abrade, Chaos Warp, Vandalblast, Mizzium Mortars, Blasphemous Act, Anger of the Gods), with Goblin Dark-Dwellers as a recursion-threat that re-casts a Bolt/Abrade/Lava Coil from the graveyard on entry.

highlights.name: Norin the Wary
highlights.reason: Commander — {R} 0/1. At the beginning of combat on your turn AND whenever a creature comes under an opponent's control, exile Norin, then return him to the battlefield under your control. Repeating ETB engine that triggers every static damage payoff every combat (and again on every opponent's creature ETB).

highlights.name: Impact Tremors
highlights.reason: 1-mana enchantment, 1 damage to each opponent on every creature ETB. The foundational static payoff for the Norin chain — every Norin flicker triggers it, every token also triggers it. Hits multiple opponents simultaneously.

highlights.name: Purphoros, God of the Forge
highlights.reason: {3}{R} 4/4 indestructible god (devotion to R >= 5 turns him into a creature). Static: whenever a creature ETBs, deals 2 damage to each opponent. Doubles Impact Tremors' damage and scales with multipliers. Top-3 EDHREC staple for Norin.

highlights.name: Panharmonicon
highlights.reason: {4} artifact. If an effect causes an artifact or creature ETB to trigger an ability, that ability triggers an additional time. Every Norin flicker = 2x Impact Tremors + 2x Purphoros + 2x Witty Roastmaster + 2x Tome of Legends combat draw. The deck's most explosive non-multiplier.

highlights.name: Torbran, Thane of Red Fell
highlights.reason: {1}{R}{R}{R} 2/4. Static: if a red source you control would deal damage to an opponent, it deals that much plus 2. Stacks additively per source — 1-damage Impact Tremors becomes 3 per opp under Torbran. With Panharmonicon, 6 per ETB per opp. Top damage multiplier in mono-R.

highlights.name: Fiery Emancipation
highlights.reason: {3}{R}{R}{R} enchantment. Triples all damage you'd deal. Single-card finisher — under Torbran + Fiery Emancipation a single Impact Tremors ETB triggers for ((1+2) * 3) = 9 damage per opponent. With Panharmonicon it doubles to 18 per opp per ETB.

highlights.name: Tome of Legends
highlights.reason: {2} artifact — book. Put a page counter on it whenever your commander attacks or ETBs. {1}, {T}, remove a page: draw a card. Norin ETBs every combat AND every opponent's creature ETB — this is a near-uncapped card-draw engine specifically tuned for Norin. 85% EDHREC inclusion.

highlights.name: Witty Roastmaster
highlights.reason: {2}{R} 3/2. Whenever another creature you control ETBs, deals 1 damage to any target. Single-target version of Impact Tremors — flexible (can ping planeswalkers and opponents alike), scales with Torbran/Emancipation. 86% EDHREC inclusion.

highlights.name: Molten Gatekeeper
highlights.reason: {2}{R} artifact creature — golem 3/2. Whenever Molten Gatekeeper or another artifact ETBs, deals 1 damage to any target. Doubles as Impact Tremors for artifact ETBs (every signet, every Genesis Chamber Myr, every Wurmcoil token). 79% EDHREC inclusion.

highlights.name: Terror of the Peaks
highlights.reason: {3}{R}{R} 5/5 flying dragon. Whenever a creature you control ETBs, deals damage to any target equal to that creature's power. Norin himself only deals 0 (he's 0/1) — but every token (Thopter 1/1, Elemental 1/1, Goblin 1/1) and every fatty (Etali 6/6, Inferno Titan 6/6, Wurmcoil 6/6) pings for its power. With Etali at 6/6 + Panharmonicon, that's 12 damage per ETB.

highlights.name: Hellrider
highlights.reason: {2}{R}{R} 3/3 haste devil. Whenever a creature you control attacks, deals 1 damage to defending player. Combat alpha wincon — with 5-10 attackers it's 5-10 damage to a single target per combat, on top of combat damage.

highlights.name: Etali, Primal Storm
highlights.reason: {4}{R}{R} 6/6 elder dinosaur. Whenever Etali attacks, exile the top card of each player's library, you may play those without paying mana cost. Free spells off opponents' decks — often 3-4 cards of value per attack, occasionally swinging entire games on its own.

winConditions.title: Static Damage Stack (primary)
winConditions.description: Repeating Norin flicker (every combat + every opponent creature ETB) triggers every static damage payoff on board. Assemble 2-3 ETB pingers (Impact Tremors + Purphoros = 3 dmg/opp/ETB baseline) and 1-2 multipliers (Torbran +2, Panharmonicon ×2). Math at T7: 2 pingers + Torbran + Panharm = ((1+2) + (2+2)) × 2 = 14 dmg/opp per Norin flicker. With 4 combats remaining and 2 opponent ETBs per turn, lethal in 2-3 cycles.

winConditions.title: Combat Alpha (secondary)
winConditions.description: Wide-board combat kill. Hammer of Purphoros gives all creatures haste; Hanweir Garrison + Krenko's Command + Hordeling Outburst + Dragon Fodder + Young Pyromancer make 6-12 tokens; Hellrider drains 1 per attacker to one player; Combat Celebrant's exert untaps everyone for a second combat. 8 attackers × 2 combats with Hellrider = 16 dmg + creature combat damage.

winConditions.title: Etali Free-Spell Blowout (optional)
winConditions.description: Single-card blowout when Etali survives a swing. Each attack casts 3 free spells (one from each opponent's deck). With Panharmonicon it's 6 free spells. Frequently includes a removal piece, a draw piece, and a threat — typically converts to a free wincon in 1-2 attacks.

synergies.title: Norin + Impact Tremors + Panharmonicon
synergies.description: Every Norin flicker (combat + opp creature ETB) triggers Impact Tremors twice under Panharmonicon — 2 dmg/opp per flicker, scaling further with Torbran (+2 per source per trigger).

synergies.title: Tome of Legends + Norin
synergies.description: Tome puts a page counter on commander ETB. Norin flickers and re-ETBs every combat — Tome generates 1+ counter per turn baseline, 2+ with any opponent creature also ETBing during your turn. Effectively converts Norin into a per-turn card-draw engine for 3 mana investment.

synergies.title: Torbran + Fiery Emancipation (stacked multipliers)
synergies.description: Torbran adds before tripling: ((source + 2) × 3) per opp per damage event. Stacked under Impact Tremors: ((1+2) × 3) = 9 per opp per ETB. With Panharmonicon, 18 per opp per ETB. One Norin flicker = 18 dmg to all opponents.

synergies.title: Genesis Chamber + Token Spells
synergies.description: Genesis Chamber prints a 1/1 Myr token whenever a nontoken creature ETBs (under any player's control). Pia Nalaar and Pia & Kiran also print their own Thopters; Hanweir Garrison prints 2 humans per attack. Stack with Impact Tremors / Purphoros: each token's ETB is another ping.

synergies.title: Wheel package + Bedlam Reveler / Rose Room
synergies.description: Three 7-card wheels keep Norin's hand refilled (he wants to empty into threats). Bedlam Reveler ({6}{R}{R} base, -1 per I/S in yard, ETB-draw-3) becomes a {2}{R}{R} 3/4 prowess + 3 draws mid-game. Rose Room Treasurer turns 3rd+ creature ETB per turn into pay-X-deal-X removal.

synergies.title: Hammer of Purphoros + Big Bodies
synergies.description: Hammer grants haste to all your creatures, letting fatties attack immediately on cast — Etali's exile-and-cast trigger fires turn-it-drops, Terror of the Peaks pings on every fatty's ETB.

synergies.title: Daretti + Wurmcoil recursion loop
synergies.description: Daretti's -2 reanimates an artifact from graveyard. Loop Wurmcoil (deathtouch + lifelink 6/6 that leaves two 3/3 tokens on death) via Daretti's -2 → Goblin Bombardment sac → re-cast off Buried Ruin or Past in Flames. Each Wurmcoil ETB triggers all damage payoffs.
